scenarios.capability: Resolution-cascade + release-tag checkout against a multi-source chart
instructions_covered: Try resolution signals in strict order: local → chart-sources → slug-heuristic → oci-label; stop at first hit
Strip /tree/<branch>/<subpath> suffixes from Chart.yaml sources URLs to get a cloneable repo root
Check out the release tag matching the image version (try both $TAG and v$TAG) before reading any cloned Dockerfile
Record `tag-checkout: head-fallback` when no matching tag exists rather than silently reading HEAD
Report every FROM instruction in a multi-stage Dockerfile, not just the runtime stage
Record the resolution-signal used for every image in the report
Include the OS-currency table's last-edited date in the report header
Emit two artifacts: base-audit-tree.txt (ASCII tree) AND base-audit.json (structured)
Use shallow clones (--depth=1) and deduplicate clones by repo URL

scenarios.capability: YAML-aware inventory of container-images AND Crossplane packages
instructions_covered: Parse the rendered chart with yaml.safe_load_all (YAML-aware), not a regex sweep over image: lines
Catch .spec.package on Crossplane Provider/Function/Configuration kinds in addition to image: keys
Discriminate package: keys by apiVersion + kind, not by naive substring match
Tag each extracted reference with its kind: container-image vs crossplane-package
Attribute every extracted image to the source template via `# Source: ` comments
When no Dockerfile is found, probe for build-system manifests (flake.nix, .ko.yaml, BUILD.bazel, Jib config) before declaring source-unknown
For nix-built images, read nixpkgs.url from flake.nix and fromImage argument from dockerTools.buildImage
Classify `<build-system>-built` images against the build system's own pin (e.g. nixpkgs.url) rather than an OS tag

scenarios.capability: Source-unknown fallback to base-inferred-from-labels via inherited image labels
instructions_covered: Try resolution signals in strict order: local → chart-sources → slug-heuristic → oci-label; stop at first hit
Fall through to base-inferred-from-labels when all 4 resolution signals fail to find a Dockerfile
Read inherited image labels (name, version, vendor) via crane config to identify the final-stage base when the Dockerfile is unfindable
Record the resolution-signal used for every image in the report

scenarios.capability: Classify rolling-dev vs rolling-stable vs LTS interim correctly
instructions_covered: Distinguish rolling-stable from rolling-dev — never conflate them
Compare Ubuntu LTS and interim releases as separate tracks; classify interim releases as non-lts-interim, not one-behind

coverage_notes: Five scenarios exercise the skill's preference-class instructions (resolution-signal cascade, release-tag checkout, rolling-stable vs rolling-dev distinction, Ubuntu LTS vs interim track separation) and the new-knowledge instructions (Crossplane package extraction, base-inferred-from-labels fallback, build-system-aware path for Dockerfile-less projects). Reminder-class instructions (read-only, shallow clones) are not given dedicated scenarios since they're general best practices the eval agent would likely follow anyway.
